correctness.rationale: For every coordinate partition, disjoint error coefficient sets give ||Cσ−C0||²≤(m−1)t²||f||², and ||C0f||=||f||. Hence the two squared triangle bounds. On C^m, with r=m−1,h=r^(−1/2)Σ_{j<=r}e_j, U_{j+1}=I±a|h><e_j| and one coordinate from each source yield Tσ=I±a√r P_h. Its singular values are |1±a√r| and 1, and each Ui has determinant 1±a/√r. At a=t below radius and a=1/√r at/above radius, the construction saturates the lower and upper constants; m=2 critical lower is approached with a↑1. This is a proof for all m and t, not extrapolation from finite tests.
